elements.element: Customer has no exclusivity obligation to Vendor.
elements.evidence: Section 2.2 expressly states that Vendor is non-exclusive and that Customer has no exclusivity obligation; Section 12.3 independently confirms that Customer made no exclusivity commitment.

elements.element: Customer has no sole-supplier obligation to Vendor.
elements.evidence: Section 2.2 expressly states that Customer has no sole-supplier obligation.

elements.element: Any exclusivity obligation binding Customer is limited to a defined product category.
elements.evidence: The condition for this limitation is demonstrably absent: the operative language expressly provides that Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation. Accordingly, there is no exclusivity requiring a product-category limitation.

elements.element: Any exclusivity obligation binding Customer is limited to 12 months.
elements.evidence: The condition for this duration limit is demonstrably absent because the rendered clause imposes no exclusivity obligation on Customer.

elements.element: Any exclusivity obligation binding Customer ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet an applicable service level.
elements.evidence: No exclusivity obligation exists under the rendered language, so there is no obligation requiring automatic termination upon a service-level failure.

elements.element: Any exclusivity obligation binding Customer ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet an applicable delivery date.
elements.evidence: No exclusivity obligation exists under the rendered language, so there is no obligation requiring automatic termination upon a missed delivery date.

result.reason: The redline directly removes the sole-and-exclusive-provider obligation and affirmatively disclaims both exclusivity and sole-supplier duties. It changes only the offending provision, harmonizes it with Sections 2.1 and 12.3, and introduces no unrelated commercial requirement or contradiction. The fallback protections are satisfied because their predicate—an exclusivity obligation binding Customer—is expressly absent.
